name.text: Solving a linear inequality with a negative coefficient and graphing it

questiontext.text:
Solve the following inequality for \(x\):

\( \displaystyle {@a@} - {@b@}x \le {@c@} \)

a) The algebraic Solution:

(Enter your answer as an inequality. Use >= for \(\ge\) and <= for \(\le\). For example, x >= 5)

Inequality: [[input:ans1]]

[[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

b) Graphical Representation:

Represent your final solution on the number line below. Drag the blue point to the correct boundary value.

(Note: This will result in an inclusive inequality(double sign) (\(\ge\)), so a closed, shaded circle is used)

[[jsxgraph input-ref-ans2="rP1" width="550px" height="120px"]] var brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-7, 2, 7, -2], axis: false, grid: false, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, pan: {enabled: false}, zoom: {enabled: false} }); /* Draw a classic number line axis with double arrows and small ticks */ var xaxis = brd.create('axis', [[0, 0], [1, 0]], { name: 'x', withLabel: true, label: {position: 'rt', offset: [-5, 15]}, firstArrow: true, lastArrow: true, strokeWidth: 1.5, ticks: { drawLabels: true, label: {offset: [0, -15]}, insertTicks: false, ticksDistance: 1, minorTicks: 0, majorHeight: 10, drawZero: true } }); /* Create the interactive glider (the boundary point) */ /* fillColor is solid blue to represent a CLOSED circle */ var p1 = brd.create('glider', [0, 0, xaxis], { name: '', size: 5, strokeColor: '#1565c0', fillColor: '#1565c0', strokeWidth: 2, snapToGrid: true, snapSizeX: 1 }); /* Draw the shaded region extending to the RIGHT border (so the arrow is visible) */ var pRight = brd.create('point', [7, 0], {visible: false}); brd.create('segment', [p1, pRight], { strokeWidth: 4, strokeColor: '#1565c0', highlight: false, lastArrow: {type: 1, size: 6} }); /* Bind the point to the hidden STACK input */ stack_jxg.bind_point(rP1, p1); stack_jxg.starts_moved(p1); [[/jsxgraph]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution:

Part 1: Algebraic Solution

To solve the inequality, we need to isolate \(x\).

First, we group the constant terms on the right side by subtracting \({@a@}\) from both sides:

\( \displaystyle \begin{aligned} -{@b@}x &\le {@c@} - {@a@} \\ -{@b@}x &\le {@c - a@} \end{aligned} \)

Next, we divide both sides by \(-{@b@}\).

Crucial Rule: Because we are dividing by a negative number, we must reverse the inequality sign.

\( \displaystyle \begin{aligned} x &\ge \frac{{@c - a@}}{-{@b@}} \\ x &\ge {@bound@} \end{aligned} \)

Hence, the correct algebraic solution is:

\( \displaystyle \boxed{x \ge {@bound@}} \)

Part 2: Graphical Representation

To represent this solution on a number line, we use a closed (shaded) circle at \({@bound@}\) because the inequality is inclusive (\(\ge\)). We then shade a thick line extending to the right to represent all numbers greater than or equal to \({@bound@}\).

[[jsxgraph width="550px" height="120px"]] var bound = {#bound#}; var brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-7, 2, 7, -2], axis: false, grid: false, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, pan: {enabled: false}, zoom: {enabled: false} }); var xaxis = brd.create('axis', [[0, 0], [1, 0]], { name: 'x', withLabel: true, label: {position: 'rt', offset: [-5, 15]}, firstArrow: true, lastArrow: true, strokeWidth: 1.5, ticks: { drawLabels: true, label: {offset: [0, -15]}, insertTicks: false, ticksDistance: 1, minorTicks: 0, majorHeight: 10, drawZero: true } }); var p1 = brd.create('point', [bound, 0], {visible: false}); var pRight = brd.create('point', [7, 0], {visible: false}); brd.create('segment', [p1, pRight], { strokeWidth: 4, strokeColor: '#1565c0', highlight: false, lastArrow: {type: 1, size: 6} }); /* Draw the closed circle */ brd.create('point', [bound, 0], {name: '', size: 5, strokeColor: '#1565c0', fillColor: '#1565c0', strokeWidth: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false}); [[/jsxgraph]]
